sub_parameters.name: Ip
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the protected object.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The port number of the protected object.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description: The port number range of the protected object.

sub_parameters.name: Protocol
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type of the protected object. Valid values:

- **tcp**: Transmission Control Protocol.
- **udp**: User Datagram Protocol.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of rows per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The policy type. Valid values:
- **default**: default mitigation policy.
- **l3**: IP-specific mitigation policy.
- **l4**: port-specific mitigation policy.

parameters.name: PortVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

- **Not specified**: queries the policy associations that attach to the default surf DPI engine.
- **2**: queries the policy associations that attach to the new stream DPI engine.
